name: SDCG
recent: SDCG 在 2026 年 11 月 23 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的季度业绩，新闻标题显示税前利润同比大跌 92% 至 RM0.24 million，尽管营收有所增长。10 月份，董事经理 Edison Kong 申报了 600 万股普通股的转让，从代名人账户转至个人账户，实益权益不变。此外，公司在 9 月底有两名主要管理人员变动。
notable: 董事经理 Edison Kong 于 2026 年 10 月 15 日转让 600 万股普通股，从代名人账户转至个人账户，实益权益不变。
公司于 2026 年 9 月 30 日宣布两名主要管理人员变动：CIK WAN RATIMA AKMAR BINTI WAN SAUDI 和 MISS GAN YEE SHAN。
risks: 新闻标题显示 2026 年第三季度税前利润同比大跌 92% 至 RM0.24 million。
董事经理进行了 600 万股的大额股份转让。
earnings: 最近一个季度（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收为 RM10.625 million，环比增长 47.2%，同比增长 115.4%；净利润为 RM0.698 million，同比增长 67.0%，净利率为 6.6%，较上一季度的 -6.7% 转正。

recent_en: SDCG announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 23 November 2026, with a news headline indicating profit before tax collapsed 92% year-on-year to RM0.24 million despite revenue growth. In October, Managing Director Edison Kong reported a transfer of 6 million ordinary shares from a nominee account to his personal account, with no change in beneficial ownership. The company also saw two changes in principal officers at the end of September.
notable_en: Managing Director Edison Kong transferred 6 million ordinary shares on 15 October 2026 from a nominee account to his personal account, with no change in beneficial ownership.
The company announced changes in two principal officers on 30 September 2026: CIK WAN RATIMA AKMAR BINTI WAN SAUDI and MISS GAN YEE SHAN.
risks_en: A news headline indicates profit before tax for Q3 2026 collapsed 92% year-on-year to RM0.24 million.
The Managing Director executed a large transfer of 6 million shares.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM10.625 million, up 47.2% quarter-on-quarter and 115.4% year-on-year; net income was RM0.698 million, up 67.0% year-on-year, with a net margin of 6.6%, turning positive from -6.7% in the previous quarter.
